name: General Quarters [UPDATE]
desc:
Everyone man your battle stations! Defend your fleet of ships from enemy attacks, which occur from both the sea and the air for as long as you can in this epic combat game! Our game is available on both PC and Mobile platforms!

The latest update adds the new and detailed Scharnhorst Class Battleship and it's escorts! Many more additions have been added to the game, so come and see for your self!

Game is still in early development. Expect some issues.

T - Mark Targets
Semi-colon - Quick Chat
